runId.description: Run id: "<kind>-<yyyymmddThhmmss>-<4hex>" with kind discovery|replay and a UTC timestamp, e.g. "replay-20260929T101500-a1b2". Names the run evidence directory.

propertyNames.description: Output name: a camelCase identifier, e.g. "savingsBalance". Keys the success result outputs record.

additionalProperties.description: One output value, typed per its OutputSpec. Decimals are strings (e.g. "1523.47").

outputs.description: Declared outputs by name, each validated against its OutputSpec. Sensitive outputs are masked in sinks.

durationMs.description: Wall-clock duration of the run, in milliseconds.

stepId.description: Step id: "s<NN>-<slug>", e.g. "s03-click-search". Assigned once by the compiler and kept stable when steps are edited or inserted, so evidence, drift reports and outcome-rule scopes keep pointing at the same step.

rungIndex.description: 0-based index of the rung that matched; always above 0 here (rung 0 matching is not drift).

rungKind.description: The kind of a locator-ladder rung: role, label, text or structural.

items.description: A step whose target resolved only on a fallback rung: a sign the primary locator is drifting (R3.4).

drift.description: Steps that resolved on a fallback rung; empty when none did.

recoveries.description: How many bounded recoveries ran (e.g. a dismissed dialog, a re-auth). Each is in the run log.

oneOf.description: The capability completed, its success condition held and every output validated.

runId.description: Run id: "<kind>-<yyyymmddThhmmss>-<4hex>" with kind discovery|replay and a UTC timestamp, e.g. "replay-20260929T101500-a1b2". Names the run evidence directory.

code.description: Outcome/condition code: snake_case, e.g. "member_not_found". Stable; calling agents branch on it.

message.description: What the app showed, e.g. "No records match your search criteria". Already redacted: sensitive values are masked before the result is built.

stepId.description: The step after which the outcome was detected.

oneOf.description: The app gave a valid business answer that is not the happy path, e.g. member_not_found. Not a failure.

runId.description: Run id: "<kind>-<yyyymmddThhmmss>-<4hex>" with kind discovery|replay and a UTC timestamp, e.g. "replay-20260929T101500-a1b2". Names the run evidence directory.

artifact.description: The artifact that ran; null when the artifact itself was invalid.

reason.description: Stable failure code. invalid_params: params failed validation. artifact_invalid: the artifact failed schema/hash checks. policy_denied: the policy refused an action. approval_required: an irreversible step needed approval and none was available (unattended). approval_rejected: an operator rejected it. target_unresolved: no locator rung matched uniquely. checkpoint_failed: a checkpoint did not hold. unknown_dialog: an unrecognised dialog appeared. app_error: the app showed an error page. recovery_exhausted: a bounded recovery ran out. output_invalid: an extracted output failed its type. session_lost: the session could not be re-established. human_aborted: an operator aborted. timeout: the run exceeded its time budget.

index.description: 0-based position of the step in the artifact.

id.description: Step id: "s<NN>-<slug>", e.g. "s03-click-search". Assigned once by the compiler and kept stable when steps are edited or inserted, so evidence, drift reports and outcome-rule scopes keep pointing at the same step.

step.description: The failing step; null when the run failed before or outside a step.

expected.description: What the step or check expected to see. Already redacted: sensitive values are masked before the result is built.

observed.description: What was actually observed. Already redacted: sensitive values are masked before the result is built.

evidence.description: Evidence captured at the failure (screenshot, snapshot).

interventionRequestId.description: The intervention request raised for this failure, if a human was asked to help.

oneOf.description: The run could not complete. Says where, what was expected, what was observed, and where the evidence is.

description: The result of a run: success | business_outcome | failure. Recoverable conditions are handled inside the run and logged; they are never a result (invariant 4).

id.description: Capability id: a lowercase kebab-case slug, e.g. "member-lookup". Stable across artifact versions.

version.description: Version of the capability that ran.

contentHash.description: contentHash of the exact artifact document that ran.

ArtifactRef.description: Identifies the exact capability artifact a run used, without embedding it.

id.description: Evidence id: a lowercase kebab-case slug unique within the run, e.g. "screenshot-0003".

kind.description: What the evidence file holds: a masked screenshot, a redacted accessibility snapshot, a Playwright trace (local only), a redacted JSON document, or a redacted log.

path.description: A POSIX path relative to the run directory, e.g. "screenshots/0003-s06-click-search.png". No leading "/", no "." or ".." segment, no backslash, no scheme: evidence can never point outside its run.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the stored file bytes, as 64 lowercase hex characters. Detects tampering.

redacted.description: Always true: the file passed the redaction layer (or screenshot masking) before it was stored. A literal, so an unredacted ref cannot be represented (invariant 3).

localOnly.description: true for files that stay on the machine that produced them (e.g. traces, which cannot be fully masked); they are never copied into shared evidence.

EvidenceRef.description: A pointer to one stored evidence file of a run. The contract carries refs, never the evidence content.
